context: A teacher introduces a new social-welfare policy in class
purpose: Explain a welfare policy; teach 福祉/世帯/原則/所得/制限/適用/財源/協議/当事者/支持

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は新しい社会福祉の制度を取り上げます。
lines.en: Today we’ll examine a new social-welfare system.
lines.style: composed teacher opening a serious topic clearly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どんな世帯が対象になるんですか？
lines.en: What kind of households are eligible?
lines.style: engaged student probing for the specifics

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 原則として、低所得の世帯が対象です。
lines.en: In principle, low-income households are the target.
lines.style: precise teacher laying out the rule plainly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 所得制限はあるんですか？
lines.style: sharp student pressing on the threshold

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、一定の所得を超えると適用されません。
lines.en: Yes, above a set income it doesn’t apply.
lines.style: measured teacher clarifying the boundary, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 財源はどこから出るんでしょう。
lines.en: Where does the funding come from?
lines.style: curious student following the money, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そこは国と自治体が協議して決めます。
lines.style: informed teacher explaining the process, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当事者の声は反映されるんですか？
lines.en: Are the voices of those affected reflected?
lines.style: principled student advocating for stakeholders, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当事者団体の支持を得ることが前提です。
lines.en: Gaining the support of stakeholder groups is a prerequisite.
lines.style: thoughtful teacher stressing legitimacy, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
